definition_en: Current magnitude, current path through the body, and exposure duration all influence injury severity.
explanation_zh: 電流大小、通過身體路徑及接觸時間都會影響傷害程度。
exam_note_en: Never infer safety from voltage or current alone.
hvac_application: Assess shock hazards during condenser service, not just nominal supply voltage. / 冷凝機維修要評估電擊危害，不能只看標稱電壓。
common_misconceptions: A voltage label alone does not predict injury. / 只看電壓標籤不能預測傷害。

definition_en: Contact between live and neutral, live and ground, or two live conductors may complete a hazardous circuit through a person.
explanation_zh: 人體接觸火線與中性線、火線與接地，或兩條火線，都可能形成危險電流路徑。
exam_note_en: A person can become part of an electrical circuit.
hvac_application: Identify potential differences between exposed HVAC terminals. / 辨識 HVAC 裸端子間電位差。
common_misconceptions: Earth contact is not required for every shock path. / 不是所有觸電路徑都必須接觸大地。

definition_en: An electric arc can travel through air, release intense energy and cause severe burns; low-voltage systems can also present arc-flash hazards.
explanation_zh: 電流經空氣形成電弧，可能釋放巨大能量造成燒傷；低壓系統也可能發生。
exam_note_en: Do not limit arc-flash risk to high voltage.
hvac_application: Include arc energy when evaluating work on motor power panels. / 評估馬達動力盤作業時也須考量電弧能量。
common_misconceptions: Low voltage does not mean no arc-flash hazard. / 低壓不代表沒有電弧閃絡危害。

exam_note_en: Do not approach exposed live conductors.
hvac_application: Recognize safe emergency response boundaries in a service area. / 辨識維修區緊急救援的安全界線。
common_misconceptions: Directly grabbing an energized casualty can injure the rescuer. / 直接拉仍帶電傷者可能傷及救援者。

common_misconceptions: A protective conductor is not a general substitute for neutral. / 保護導體不是可任意替代的中性線。

explanation_zh: GFCI 比較流出與返回電流是否失衡，偵測漏電時斷開。

common_misconceptions: GFCI does not prevent all line-to-neutral shocks or balanced overloads. / GFCI 不防止全部火線中性線觸電或平衡過載。

explanation_zh: 電流過大使熔絲熔斷，動作後須更換。

explanation_zh: 斷路器在特定故障或過電流條件下跳脫，排除原因後可重置。

definition_en: Identify and isolate all hazardous energy, apply the applicable lockout/tagout procedure, and verify absence of voltage before work. For qualified personnel, the applicable verification procedure includes a suitable rated contact instrument whose operation is checked on a known live reference before and after the absence test; a non-contact detector alone is insufficient.
explanation_zh: 辨識並隔離全部危險能源、依適用程序上鎖掛牌，工作前驗證無電。合資格人員依適用驗證程序使用額定合適的接觸式儀器，並在無電測試前後以已知帶電參考確認儀器有效；單靠非接觸驗電筆不夠。此為程序原理，不是未受訓者帶電操作指南。
exam_note_en: Informing occupants is not a replacement for lockout and verification.
hvac_application: Identify all sources feeding indoor and outdoor HVAC sections before service. / 維修前辨識室內外 HVAC 部分的全部供電。
common_misconceptions: Thermostat off does not isolate all energy. / 關恆溫器不會隔離全部能源。

definition_en: Capacitors can retain hazardous charge after power is removed; follow manufacturer-approved discharge and verification procedures.
explanation_zh: 斷電後電容仍可能殘留危險電荷，應遵循原廠放電及驗證程序。

hvac_application: Account for run-capacitor stored energy after disconnecting a condenser. / 冷凝機斷電後仍須考慮運轉電容儲能。
common_misconceptions: A fixed discharge resistor and waiting time are not universal. / 固定放電電阻及等待時間不能通用。

explanation_zh: 檢查表筆工具、避免導電首飾與潮濕接觸、使用合適防護及額定設備，避免帶電處附近使用金屬梯。

definition_en: A magnetic starter combines a contactor with motor overload protection.
explanation_zh: 電磁啟動器結合接觸器與馬達過載保護。
exam_note_en: Overload protection does not replace short-circuit protection.
hvac_application: Separate contactor switching from overload protection in a starter. / 在啟動器中區分接觸器切換與過載保護。
common_misconceptions: A starter may still require separate branch short-circuit protection. / 啟動器仍可能需要獨立分路短路保護。

definition_en: Pole counts independently switched circuits; throw describes selectable contact positions or paths.
explanation_zh: pole 表獨立切換迴路組數；throw 表切換位置或路徑。
exam_note_en: SPST and DPST are common switch descriptions.
hvac_application: Choose SPDT for one circuit selection or DPST for two on/off poles. / 一路選擇用 SPDT，兩極通斷可用 DPST。
common_misconceptions: Poles count independent circuits; throws count selections, not amperes. / 極數計獨立迴路，投數計選擇，不是安培數。

definition_en: A disconnect provides a means to isolate equipment from its electrical supply.
explanation_zh: 隔離開關用於將設備與供電分離。
exam_note_en: Follow rated isolation and lockout procedures.
hvac_application: Identify line-side and load-side boundaries of an HVAC disconnect. / 辨識 HVAC 隔離開關電源側及負載側界線。
common_misconceptions: An open handle does not prove upstream terminals dead. / 開把手不證明上游端子無電。

definition_en: A simple cooling call closes on temperature rise; a simple heating call opens on temperature rise in the course example.
explanation_zh: 簡化課堂例子：冷氣溫升閉合、暖氣溫升斷開。
exam_note_en: Actual thermostat contacts and control logic vary by design.

common_misconceptions: Thermostat logic varies with equipment and mode. / 恆溫器邏輯依設備及模式變化。

definition_en: Pressure-operated contacts can open or close on rising pressure according to intended control or safety function.
explanation_zh: 壓力開關可依用途設計為壓升斷開或閉合。
exam_note_en: High- and low-pressure protection behavior depends on the circuit.
hvac_application: Interpret pressure-safety action from its cut-in and cut-out specification. / 依切入切出規格解讀壓力保護動作。
common_misconceptions: Not every pressure switch opens on pressure rise. / 不是所有壓力開關都壓升斷開。

definition_en: Push buttons may have normally open or normally closed contacts for start/stop controls.
explanation_zh: 按鈕可使用 NO 或 NC 接點作啟停控制。
exam_note_en: A STOP button is often NC in a conventional three-wire starter circuit.
hvac_application: Trace a momentary start circuit with and without a holding contact. / 追蹤有無自保持接點的瞬時啟動電路。
common_misconceptions: A momentary start button alone does not latch a coil. / 瞬時啟動鈕本身不使線圈保持。

definition_en: Thermal overload devices respond to heating associated with excess motor current.
explanation_zh: 熱過載裝置依過電流引起的熱效應動作。
exam_note_en: Bimetallic elements are a common implementation.
hvac_application: Interpret delayed overload trips without defeating motor protection. / 解讀延遲過載跳脫而不破壞馬達保護。
common_misconceptions: A trip is a reason to investigate, not to bypass protection. / 跳脫是調查原因，不是旁路保護的理由。

definition_en: Magnetic current-operated protection responds to current according to a specified trip characteristic. Its role as overload or short-circuit protection depends on the device design and rating.
explanation_zh: 磁性電流保護依指定跳脫特性動作；是否具過載或短路保護功能，須看裝置設計與額定，不能一概而論。
exam_note_en: Do not confuse overload with short-circuit protection.
hvac_application: Read device trip curves before identifying magnetic protection functions. / 辨識磁性保護功能前先讀跳脫曲線。
common_misconceptions: Magnetic does not by itself specify overload versus short-circuit duty. / magnetic 一詞本身不指定過載或短路用途。

definition_en: A transformer changes AC voltage through magnetic coupling; many HVAC controls use approximately 24 VAC secondary voltage.
explanation_zh: 變壓器藉磁耦合改變交流電壓；HVAC 控制常使用約 24 VAC。
exam_note_en: Example 240 VAC primary to 24 VAC secondary.
hvac_application: Respect secondary VA and coil inrush when sizing 24 VAC controls. / 設計 24 VAC 控制須尊重次級 VA 及線圈湧入需求。
common_misconceptions: Low secondary voltage does not mean unlimited capacity or no hazards. / 次級低壓不代表容量無限或無危害。
